HS IXIARO is a suspension for injection supplied in 0.5 mL single dose syringes. For children 2 months to <3 years of age, a single dose is 0.25 mL. For individuals 3 years of age and older, a single dose is 0.5 mL. [See Dosage and Administration (2.1)]
